description: This file defines the 'PurgeEmployee' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\Event' namespace. It encapsulates a maintenance event related to purging (deleting or removing) an employee identified by an employee number. The class contains a constructor to set the employee number and a getter method to retrieve it.

classes.name: PurgeEmployee
classes.description: Represents an event for purging an employee, storing the employee's number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with the employee's number.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with this purge event.
